overview: A complete, interactive nonprofit website for Kinderhilfswerk Society (KHW-India) with public pages and a protected admin dashboard, all running on local mock data in the browser.
features: Public pages: Home, About, Programs, Impact Stories, Get Involved, Events, Partners, Transparency, Contact, Donate
Dark mode toggle and English/Hindi language switcher
Reusable testimonials carousel and animated impact stats
Protected admin dashboard with live analytics, charts, and CSV exports
Content management for stories, programs, volunteers, events, partners, and reports
Working forms that store data and update the dashboard live
